cases.input: Create an interview plan from a role capability map with critical gaps in P&L, turnaround attribution and an interview-only matrix-conflict criterion.
requiredBehaviors: ask concrete scope and attribution questions
translate behavioral criteria into situation-based questions
preserve evidence context and criterion linkage
separate interview topics from reference-check topics
skillAnchors: What must a human clarify next?

cases.input: Two public sources disagree on the candidate's responsibility level during the same period. Prepare a question to reconcile the evidence.
requiredBehaviors: reference the conflicting context without accusation
preserve the unresolved state until the answer is obtained
forbiddenBehaviors: silently pick one source as true without evidence

cases.input: A draft interview plan asks about family planning, scores podcast charisma, and gives a global 9 out of 10 candidate fit after the interview.
requiredBehaviors: remove the global candidate fit score
retain only role-linked professional evidence questions
forbiddenBehaviors: diagnose personality from public or interview behavior
